goal: Count same-species within-site next-year detected/nondetected transitions conditional on known prior study-month source pool in exactly 19 burned-pilot studies. No island colonization, demographic rescue or predictive claim.
source_join: Use exact frozen pilot STUDY_ID only, before any taxon column is inspected; holdout taxon responses are not queried.

physical_sampling_frame.site_proxy: study + rounded latitude/longitude 5 decimals, not a permanent plot identity
physical_sampling_frame.survey_event: unique within-study/month/site/year nonblank SAMPLE_DESC; this field is constructed in the original BioTIME source
physical_sampling_frame.pair: identical study/site/month in consecutive calendar years
physical_sampling_frame.month: valid 1..12, same calendar month in both years
physical_sampling_frame.depth_or_method_match: NOT verified from study metadata; descriptive quality limitation

taxon_eligibility.valid_name: nonblank source-validated name; never displayed per species
taxon_eligibility.detection: ABUNDANCE>0 or BIOMASS>0, ignoring nonfinite values
taxon_eligibility.missing_site_taxon_record: Not detected in a sampled event, NOT a verified true ecological absence

prior_source_pool.year: t only; t+1 must not define denominator
prior_source_pool.species: detected at one or more sampled sites in study-month-year at t
prior_source_pool.source_sites: distinct 5-decimal coordinate sites with prior-year positive detection
prior_source_pool.recipient: for prior non-detections, focal recipient does not count among positive sources

denominator: For each paired sampled site-month-year and each taxon observed somewhere in prior-year study-month regional pool, classify target sample detection t/t+1 into 00,01,10,11.

outcomes.10: detected t then not detected t+1; no local extinction inference
outcomes.00: not detected in either sampled target month
outcomes.01: not detected in t but detected at least once in t+1 with known t regional source; detection transition only
outcomes.new_external: detected t+1 but not in t regional source pool, excluded from 00/01 pool denominator

quality_sensitivity.01_replicated: t+1 taxon detected in >=2 distinct SAMPLE_DESC events among eligible recipient pairs
quality_sensitivity.10_replicated: t taxon detected in >=2 distinct SAMPLE_DESC events; other year lacks detection
quality_sensitivity.survey_effort: report within-pair n_events distribution, per-study event and taxon attrition, and realm separation
quality_sensitivity.sample_method: not proven identical by event-count or same-month matching

reporting.per_study: 19 rows with study ID, realm and cell counts; no species identifiers or sites exported
reporting.metrics: raw cell counts, rates with denominator explicitly shown; descriptive only
reporting.reconciliation: all 00+01+10+11 exactly equal sum of predeclared prior source pools across comparable target-year pairs

stop_rules: Source MD5 mismatch or RDS changes
Original v1_251 hashed pilot/holdout identities mismatch
Required original source taxon/schema columns missing
No matched sampled pairs / eligible species detection
Do not enlarge pilot or inspect reserved holdout to fix unsupported result
